effects.title: Curl-noise flow field
effects.description: Thousands of particles follow a current that never tangles
effects.descriptionZh: 成千上万的粒子顺着一股永不缠结的水流前进

effects.title: Drone light show
effects.description: Lights fly between shapes without crossing paths
effects.descriptionZh: 灯光在图形之间飞行，航线从不交叉

effects.title: Particle life
effects.description: Specks chase and flee until creatures form; drag to stir
effects.descriptionZh: 彩色微粒彼此追逐、逃离，直到聚成生物；拖动可搅动

effects.title: Cloud chamber
effects.description: Invisible radiation leaves misty trails that curl and fade
effects.descriptionZh: 看不见的辐射留下雾状轨迹，卷曲后渐渐消散

effects.title: Spiral galaxy
effects.description: Arms of stars wind slowly round a bright core
effects.descriptionZh: 星辰组成的长臂绕着明亮的核心缓缓转动

effects.title: Strange attractor
effects.description: Glowing trails loop round an apple shape, never repeating
effects.descriptionZh: 发光的轨迹绕着苹果状的外形打转，从不重复

effects.title: Slime mould maps Tokyo
effects.description: A web spreads between cities and thins into rail-like routes
effects.descriptionZh: 一张网在城市之间蔓延，再收窄成铁路般的线路

effects.title: Lightning arcs
effects.description: Forked bolts crackle out from your pointer
effects.descriptionZh: 分叉的电光从你的指针处噼啪迸出

effects.title: Iron filings
effects.description: Steel slivers hop into loops round a hidden magnet; drag it
effects.descriptionZh: 钢屑跳起，围着一块隐藏的磁铁排成环线；拖动可移动磁铁

effects.title: Galton board
effects.description: Beads bounce down through pegs and pile up into a bell curve
effects.descriptionZh: 珠子在钉阵间弹跳落下，堆成一条钟形曲线

effects.title: Pin art
effects.description: A hand and a face rise in steel relief; press to push it back
effects.descriptionZh: 一只手和一张脸从钢针中浮起；按下可把钢针推回

effects.title: 3D paper confetti
effects.description: Two cannons fire coloured bits that tumble and flutter down
effects.descriptionZh: 两门礼炮喷出彩色碎片，翻转着飘落

effects.title: Firefly sync
effects.description: Random flashes slowly fall into step; move to startle them
effects.descriptionZh: 杂乱的闪光渐渐合上同一个节拍；移动指针可惊散它们

effects.title: GPU particles (262k)
effects.description: Glowing threads of dots stream and curl through 3D space
effects.descriptionZh: 发光的点汇成细丝，在三维空间中流动、盘绕

effects.title: Hydrogen orbitals
effects.description: A cloud of points flows from one electron shape to the next
effects.descriptionZh: 一团点云从一种电子形状流向下一种

effects.title: Roche limit
effects.description: A rubble moon spirals in, tears apart and winds into a ring
effects.descriptionZh: 碎石卫星盘旋坠落，被撕开，卷成一圈光环

effects.title: Starling murmuration
effects.description: A flock folds and ripples as a falcon dives through
effects.descriptionZh: 游隼俯冲而过，鸟群随之折叠、起伏

effects.title: States of matter
effects.description: Atoms cool from gas to droplets to crystal, then melt again
effects.descriptionZh: 原子从气体冷却成液滴再结成晶体，然后再次熔化

effects.title: Calligraphy brush
effects.description: Writes 永 stroke by stroke, running dry and pooling at turns
effects.descriptionZh: 一笔一画写出“永”字，长笔见飞白，转折处墨色积聚

effects.title: Harmonograph
effects.description: A swinging pen draws a rosette that spirals in as it slows
effects.descriptionZh: 摆动的笔画出玫瑰花纹，随着减速向中心收拢

effects.title: Chladni plate
effects.description: Buzzing brass shakes sand into new figures as the tone rises
effects.descriptionZh: 振动的黄铜板随着音调升高，把沙子抖成新的图形

effects.title: Crystal growth (DLA)
effects.description: Black fern-like branches creep across stone from a crack
effects.descriptionZh: 黑色的蕨状枝杈从裂缝出发，爬满石面

effects.title: Wind tunnel
effects.description: Smoke curls into eddies behind a shape; drag to move it
effects.descriptionZh: 烟在物体后方卷成涡旋；拖动可移动物体

effects.title: Fireworks
effects.description: Five kinds of shell burst overhead; tap to launch your own
effects.descriptionZh: 五种礼花弹在空中炸开；点击可发射你自己的一枚

effects.title: Bokeh
effects.description: Blurred lights drift as the focus slowly pulls through them
effects.descriptionZh: 焦点缓缓推移，模糊的光点在画面中漂浮

effects.title: Nebula
effects.description: Glowing gas swirls round a bright star, cut by dark dust
effects.descriptionZh: 发光的气体绕着一颗亮星翻涌，被暗色尘带切开

effects.title: Ink fluid
effects.description: Move through the water to push glowing dye into swirls
effects.descriptionZh: 在水中移动指针，把发光的染料推成漩涡

effects.title: Liquid image distortion
effects.description: A photo ripples like water; move over it to stir it harder
effects.descriptionZh: 照片像水面一样荡漾；在上面移动可搅得更厉害

effects.title: Lava lamp
effects.description: Warm wax stretches off the pool, rises, cools and sinks
effects.descriptionZh: 温热的蜡从底部拉伸而起，上升、冷却，再沉下去

effects.title: Fire & smoke
effects.description: Flames lick stacked logs as sparks rise into the night
effects.descriptionZh: 火舌舔着堆叠的木柴，火星升入夜空

effects.title: Lava flow
effects.description: Molten rock pours from a crater and runs down the gullies
effects.descriptionZh: 炽热的岩浆从火山口涌出，顺着沟壑流下

effects.title: Ferrofluid
effects.description: Black oil spikes over a magnet; move it, or tap to switch it off
effects.descriptionZh: 黑色油液在磁铁上竖起尖刺；移动指针拖动磁铁，点击可关掉它

effects.title: Paper marbling
effects.description: Bands of paint swirl after the stylus as you move over them
effects.descriptionZh: 移动指针，颜料带就跟着画针卷出纹路

effects.title: Rain on glass
effects.description: Drops slide down a window, each holding the city upside down
effects.descriptionZh: 水珠沿窗玻璃滑落，每颗都映出颠倒的城市

effects.title: Dripping text
effects.description: Paint drips off the letters, stretches thin and snaps
effects.descriptionZh: 颜料从字母上滴落，拉长变细后断开

effects.title: Liquid mercury
effects.description: Silver beads roll and merge; sweep through fast to split them
effects.descriptionZh: 银色珠子滚动、合并；快速划过可把它们打散

effects.title: Kelvin–Helmholtz clouds
effects.description: A sunset sky rolls up into a row of breaking waves
effects.descriptionZh: 夕阳下的天空卷成一排翻滚的浪

effects.title: Paint swirl
effects.description: Colour rings wind into spirals; circle over them to stir
effects.descriptionZh: 色环卷成螺旋；在上面画圈可搅动

effects.title: SPH water tank
effects.description: Waves roll end to end in a rocking glass box; move to tilt it
effects.descriptionZh: 玻璃箱来回摇晃，波浪从一头涌向另一头；移动指针可倾斜它

effects.title: Open ocean
effects.description: Grey, windy waves roll in; move to slide the sun’s glow
effects.descriptionZh: 灰色海浪迎风涌来；移动指针可挪动阳光的亮斑

effects.title: Honey pour
effects.description: A golden thread coils into a column; drag to move the spoon
effects.descriptionZh: 一缕金色细流盘成柱子；拖动可移动勺子

effects.title: Portal
effects.description: A desert gate opens onto a night sea; fly through and back
effects.descriptionZh: 沙漠中的石门通向夜海；镜头穿门而过再飞回来

effects.title: Glass lens refraction
effects.description: Move to slide a magnifier with rainbow edges over the scene
effects.descriptionZh: 移动指针，让一块带彩边的放大镜在画面上滑过

effects.title: Dust to the wind
effects.description: A marble bust blows away, then pulls itself back together
effects.descriptionZh: 大理石胸像化作飞散的颗粒，又重新聚合

effects.title: Cloth reveal
effects.description: Red silk settles over a hidden star, then slides off
effects.descriptionZh: 红色丝绸盖住一颗隐藏的星，随后滑落

effects.title: Liquid metal
effects.description: A chrome blob rises from the pool, lets go and splashes back
effects.descriptionZh: 一团铬液从池中升起、脱离，又落回溅起水花

effects.title: Mandelbulb fractal
effects.description: A knobbly 3D shape slowly breathes and reshapes its crevices
effects.descriptionZh: 一个疙疙瘩瘩的三维形体缓缓呼吸，裂隙不断变化

effects.title: Infinite tunnel
effects.description: Fly forever down a bending tube lit by racing pulses
effects.descriptionZh: 沿着一条弯曲的管道无尽前行，脉冲光飞速掠过

effects.title: Glass prism
effects.description: As it turns, every stripe behind it splits into a rainbow
effects.descriptionZh: 它一转，背后的每条条纹都散成彩虹

effects.title: Dot globe with arcs
effects.description: Flight paths hop between continents; drag to spin the world
effects.descriptionZh: 航线在大陆之间跳跃；拖动可转动地球

effects.title: Extruded 3D type
effects.description: A solid word turns under a chrome shine; move to steer it
effects.descriptionZh: 一个立体的词在铬光下转动；移动指针可操控方向

effects.title: Holographic card
effects.description: Tilts toward your pointer as rainbow foil and glare slide
effects.descriptionZh: 朝你的指针倾斜，彩虹箔面和反光随之滑动

effects.title: Iridescent torus knot
effects.description: A colour-shifting tube loops through itself as stripes flow
effects.descriptionZh: 一根变色的管子自我缠绕，条纹沿着它流动

effects.title: Jelly cube
effects.description: Drag and throw it to see it wobble; tap to make it hop
effects.descriptionZh: 拖动后扔出去，看它晃动；点击让它跳起

effects.title: Neon geodesic sphere
effects.description: Light pulses race along the struts of a turning wire ball
effects.descriptionZh: 光脉冲沿着旋转线框球的支杆飞驰

effects.title: Spheres on a knot
effects.description: Glossy balls glide along a loop, reflecting each other
effects.descriptionZh: 光亮的球沿着环路滑行，彼此映照

effects.title: SDF shape morph
effects.description: Chrome melts from sphere to cube to ring, twisting as it goes
effects.descriptionZh: 铬面从球体融成立方体再变成圆环，一路扭转

effects.title: Paper fold
effects.description: A printed sheet creases shut and opens, four different ways
effects.descriptionZh: 一张印刷纸折起又展开，共有四种折法

effects.title: Menger sponge
effects.description: A brass cube full of ever-smaller holes turns in the light
effects.descriptionZh: 一个布满越来越小孔洞的黄铜立方体在光中转动

effects.title: Gyroid fly-through
effects.description: Glide past endless curving walls that change colour into fog
effects.descriptionZh: 穿行于无尽的弯曲墙壁之间，墙壁在雾中变换颜色

effects.title: Black hole
effects.description: A bright disc arches over and under the shadow, like Interstellar
effects.descriptionZh: 明亮的圆盘在阴影上下弯成拱形，就像《星际穿越》

effects.title: Tesseract
effects.description: A four-dimensional cube turns and seems to flip inside out
effects.descriptionZh: 一个四维立方体在转动，仿佛把自己里外翻转

effects.title: Soap bubble
effects.description: Wobbles in the air as rainbow colours swirl over its skin
effects.descriptionZh: 在空中轻轻颤动，彩虹般的颜色在表面流转

effects.title: Terrain flyover
effects.description: Fly up a fjord between snowy peaks mirrored in calm water
effects.descriptionZh: 沿峡湾飞行，雪峰倒映在平静的水面上

effects.title: Volumetric clouds
effects.description: Drift through a sunlit sky with dark bellies and bright edges
effects.descriptionZh: 穿过阳光照耀的天空，底部幽暗，边缘发亮

effects.title: Brilliant-cut diamond
effects.description: Turns under strip lights, flashing white and coloured fire
effects.descriptionZh: 在条形灯下转动，闪出白光和彩色火彩

effects.title: Klein bottle
effects.description: A see-through shape whose neck passes through its own side
effects.descriptionZh: 一个透明形体，颈部穿过自己的侧壁

effects.title: Inflated type
effects.description: A word puffs up like a foil balloon, bounces, then lets down
effects.descriptionZh: 一个词像铝箔气球一样鼓起、弹一下，又瘪下去

effects.title: Melting chrome logo
effects.description: Letters slump into a puddle, then pull back into the word
effects.descriptionZh: 字母塌成一摊，再重新拉起成原来的词

effects.title: DNA double helix
effects.description: Turns while its two strands peel apart and zip back together
effects.descriptionZh: 转动的同时，两条链分开又重新合拢

effects.title: 3D fractal tree
effects.description: Grows branch by branch, sways in the wind and sheds petals
effects.descriptionZh: 一枝一枝地长出来，随风摇摆，飘落花瓣

effects.title: Shatter & rewind
effects.description: A ball smashes glass in slow motion, then time runs back
effects.descriptionZh: 一颗球以慢动作击碎玻璃，随后时间倒流

effects.title: Snow globe
effects.description: Drag across it to shake the flakes around a tiny moonlit cabin
effects.descriptionZh: 在上面横向拖动，摇起月光下小木屋周围的雪花

effects.title: Meadow
effects.description: Gusts sweep across sunlit grass; move to turn the wind
effects.descriptionZh: 阵风掠过阳光下的草地；移动指针可改变风向

effects.title: CRT monitor
effects.description: An old screen warms up, plays Breakout and shrinks to a dot
effects.descriptionZh: 老式屏幕预热、自己玩起打砖块，然后缩成一个光点

effects.title: CMYK halftone
effects.description: Drifting colour prints in dots; move over it to swell them
effects.descriptionZh: 流动的色彩被印成网点；在上面移动可让网点膨胀

effects.title: Reaction–diffusion
effects.description: Coral-like patterns spread; move over them to seed more
effects.descriptionZh: 珊瑚般的花纹不断蔓延；在上面移动可播下更多

effects.title: Guilloche spirograph
effects.description: Fine looping lines form rosettes like a banknote engraving
effects.descriptionZh: 细密的环线组成钞票雕版般的玫瑰花纹

effects.title: RGB-split glitch
effects.description: A picture breaks into colour copies as slices jump in bursts
effects.descriptionZh: 画面裂成几份彩色副本，横条一阵阵跳动

effects.title: Domain-warped marble
effects.description: Smoky veins of colour fold into each other and keep flowing
effects.descriptionZh: 烟雾般的色脉彼此折叠，不停流动

effects.title: Truchet flow
effects.description: Dashes run along winding paths that reroute as tiles turn
effects.descriptionZh: 短线沿着蜿蜒的路径流动，瓷砖一转，路径就改道

effects.title: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Glass chips tumble in mirrored slices round a turning centre
effects.descriptionZh: 玻璃碎片在镜像切片中翻滚，绕着旋转的中心

effects.title: Ordered dither
effects.description: A small 3D scene drawn in two inks that read as soft grey
effects.descriptionZh: 用两种墨色画出的小型三维场景，看上去像柔和的灰

effects.title: Pen sketch
effects.description: Plaster shapes turn on a stand, drawn in shaky hatched ink
effects.descriptionZh: 石膏几何体在转台上旋转，用颤动的排线墨水画出

effects.title: ASCII render
effects.description: A turning 3D sponge drawn only in amber text characters
effects.descriptionZh: 一块旋转的三维海绵，全部用琥珀色字符画成

effects.title: Pixel sort
effects.description: Bright sky pours down a sunset in streaks, then drains away
effects.descriptionZh: 日落天空的亮色倾泻成条纹，再慢慢退去

effects.title: Hyperbolic tiling
effects.description: Woven stars shrink toward the rim forever, like Escher’s prints
effects.descriptionZh: 编织的星形向圆的边缘无限缩小，像埃舍尔的版画

effects.title: Stained glass
effects.description: Coloured shafts of sun cross a church; move to shift the light
effects.descriptionZh: 彩色的阳光光柱穿过教堂；移动指针可移动光线

effects.title: Op-art moiré
effects.description: Fine rings overlap into sweeping fringes; move to shift one set
effects.descriptionZh: 细密的圆环叠出大片波纹；移动指针可挪动其中一组

effects.title: Bauhaus composition
effects.description: A poster of bold primary tiles keeps rearranging in ripples
effects.descriptionZh: 一张三原色方块海报不断以波浪方式重新排列

effects.title: Memphis pattern
effects.description: 80s squiggles and zigzags drift; move to shift the layers
effects.descriptionZh: 80 年代的波浪线和锯齿飘过；移动指针可错开图层

effects.title: Phyllotaxis
effects.description: Seeds pack a sunflower head; move sideways to change the angle
effects.descriptionZh: 种子排满向日葵花盘；左右移动可改变角度

effects.title: Rose curve
effects.description: A glowing pen draws petal shapes; move to pick the next one
effects.descriptionZh: 发光的笔描出花瓣图形；移动指针可选下一个

effects.title: Superformula
effects.description: One outline morphs from stars to flowers; move to reshape it
effects.descriptionZh: 一条轮廓从星形变成花形；移动指针可改变形状

effects.title: Hex wave
effects.description: Honeycomb columns rise in rings; tap or move to add more
effects.descriptionZh: 蜂巢柱一圈圈升起；点击或移动可添加更多

effects.title: Wave lines
effects.description: Stacked hairlines roll into ridges; move to lift a peak
effects.descriptionZh: 层层细线起伏成山脊；移动指针可拉起一座峰

effects.title: Starburst
effects.description: Spinning rays stream outward; move to cross in a second fan
effects.descriptionZh: 旋转的光芒向外涌出；移动指针可叠上第二组射线

effects.title: Log spiral
effects.description: Arms pour inward forever and stream out of your pointer
effects.descriptionZh: 金蓝两色的长臂无尽地涌向中心，又从你的指针处流出

effects.title: Woven tartan
effects.description: Plaid cloth slides by up close, every thread visible
effects.descriptionZh: 格子呢近距离滑过，每根线都清晰可见

effects.title: Clifford attractor
effects.description: A silky ribbon of light keeps reshaping; move to bend it
effects.descriptionZh: 一条丝绸般的光带不断变形；移动指针可弯折它

effects.title: Barnsley fern
effects.description: Scattered dots build a leafy frond; move to blow it about
effects.descriptionZh: 零散的点拼出一片带小叶的叶子；移动指针可吹动它

effects.title: Chaos game
effects.description: Random jumps build nested triangles; move to pull a corner
effects.descriptionZh: 随机跳跃搭出层层嵌套的三角形；移动指针可拉动一个角

effects.title: Dragon curve
effects.description: A paper strip unfolds fold by fold; move to set the angle
effects.descriptionZh: 一条纸带一折一折地展开；移动指针可调整角度

effects.title: Dot-matrix wave
effects.description: Round lights breathe in rolling bands; move to raise a bulge
effects.descriptionZh: 圆形灯点随起伏的波带呼吸；移动指针可拱起一块

effects.title: Metaballs
effects.description: Glossy blobs flow into each other; your pointer is one too
effects.descriptionZh: 光亮的液滴彼此融合；你的指针也是其中一滴

effects.title: Aurora curtains
effects.description: Green light pleats across a starry sky; move to lift a fold
effects.descriptionZh: 绿色光幕在星空中起褶；移动指针可掀起一道褶

effects.title: Ripple grid
effects.description: Graph paper floats on water; tap or move to send rings
effects.descriptionZh: 方格纸漂在水面上；点击或移动可荡出水圈

effects.title: Voronoi cells
effects.description: Glass panes drift and swap neighbours; move to push them
effects.descriptionZh: 玻璃块漂移着交换邻居；移动指针可把它们推开

effects.title: Quasicrystal
effects.description: Golden rosettes bloom outward, never repeating; move to reshape
effects.descriptionZh: 金色玫瑰花纹向外绽放，永不重复；移动指针可改变它们

effects.title: Topographic contours
effects.description: Map lines shift with the land; move for a hill, press to dig
effects.descriptionZh: 地图线条随起伏变化；移动可隆起山丘，按下可挖出凹坑

effects.title: Wave interference
effects.description: Ripples from two points cross in bands; move to shift one
effects.descriptionZh: 两个点发出的波纹交叉成条纹；移动指针可挪动其中一个

effects.title: Plasma
effects.description: Neon coral and ice-blue blobs swell and fold; move to steer
effects.descriptionZh: 珊瑚色与冰蓝色的霓虹团块膨胀、翻折；移动指针可引导

effects.title: Heatmap
effects.description: Cells glow hotter as heat drifts; move to leave a warm trail
effects.descriptionZh: 格子随热量漂移而变热；移动指针可留下一道暖痕

effects.title: Julia set
effects.description: A glowing fractal melts from lobes to spirals; move to steer
effects.descriptionZh: 发光的分形从团块融化成螺旋；移动指针可引导

effects.title: Wave function collapse
effects.description: An island map fills itself in; drag to wipe a patch and regrow
effects.descriptionZh: 一张岛屿地图自己填满；拖动可抹掉一块，让它重新长出

effects.title: Brian’s Brain
effects.description: Tiny ships streak, crash and spawn new ones; drag to draw
effects.descriptionZh: 小飞船疾驰、相撞，又生出新的；拖动可画出细胞

effects.title: Langton’s ant
effects.description: Scribbles a messy blob for ages, then marches off in a line
effects.descriptionZh: 先乱涂一大团，很久之后突然沿直线走开

effects.title: Falling sand
effects.description: Move to pour grains that pile into dunes and soak up water
effects.descriptionZh: 移动指针倒下细粒，堆成沙丘，还会吸水

effects.title: Doom fire
effects.description: Chunky pixel flames sway and roar back; drag to add heat
effects.descriptionZh: 粗颗粒的像素焰舌摇曳，弱下去又窜起来；拖动可加热

effects.title: Water ripples
effects.description: Drops ring across a sunny pond; drag for a wake, tap to splash
effects.descriptionZh: 水滴在阳光下的池塘荡开圆圈；拖动留下尾迹，点击溅起水花

effects.title: Double pendulums
effects.description: Nine swing as one, then split apart; move to hold the pivot
effects.descriptionZh: 九个起初同步摆动，随后彻底分开；移动指针可握住支点

effects.title: N-body orbits
effects.description: Planets loop twin suns in rosettes; tap to drop a new one
effects.descriptionZh: 行星绕着双星画出玫瑰轨迹；点击可投放一颗新行星

effects.title: Vortex drain
effects.description: Streaks spiral into a hole that follows your pointer
effects.descriptionZh: 条条流光旋入一个跟随指针的洞

effects.title: Plexus
effects.description: Drifting dots link up with fine lines; move to gather them
effects.descriptionZh: 漂浮的点用细线相连；移动指针可把它们聚拢

effects.title: Lenia
effects.description: Soft lifelike blobs glide, spin and heal; drag to wound one
effects.descriptionZh: 柔软如生物的团块滑行、旋转、自愈；拖动可伤到一只

effects.title: Differential growth
effects.description: An ink line outgrows the page and folds into a maze
effects.descriptionZh: 一条墨线长得比纸面还长，只好折成迷宫

effects.title: Snowflake growth
effects.description: Ice grows six branching arms, then a fresh crystal starts
effects.descriptionZh: 冰晶伸出六条分叉的臂，然后新的晶体开始生长

effects.title: Mud cracks
effects.description: Wet clay dries into curled plates; drag to wet a patch again
effects.descriptionZh: 湿泥干成卷边的泥片；拖动可再次打湿一块

effects.title: Digital rain
effects.description: Green glyphs pour down in columns behind bright white heads
effects.descriptionZh: 绿色字符成列落下，每列前端是明亮的白色

effects.title: Warp starfield
effects.description: Stars stretch into streaks as speed builds; move to steer
effects.descriptionZh: 速度越快，星星拉得越长；移动指针可转向

effects.title: Oscilloscope
effects.description: A green beam draws looping figures; move to turn the knobs
effects.descriptionZh: 绿色光束画出循环图形；移动指针可转动旋钮

effects.title: Copper bars
effects.description: Shiny Amiga-style stripes roll over and under each other
effects.descriptionZh: 闪亮的 Amiga 风格色条前后交错地滚动

effects.title: Checker tunnel
effects.description: Fly down an endless twisting tube of squares into the dark
effects.descriptionZh: 沿着一条扭曲的无尽方格管道冲向黑暗

effects.title: Rotozoom
effects.description: A pattern of nested squares spins and zooms like a 90s demo
effects.descriptionZh: 嵌套方块图案旋转缩放，像 90 年代的演示程序

effects.title: Seven-segment clock
effects.description: A live LED readout ticks hundredths, unlit bars faint behind
effects.descriptionZh: LED 读数实时跳到百分之一秒，未亮的笔画隐约可见

effects.title: LED dot-matrix sign
effects.description: Amber text scrolls across a board of round glowing bulbs
effects.descriptionZh: 琥珀色文字滚过一块圆灯珠面板

effects.title: Radar sweep
effects.description: A turning beam lights up blips that fade until the next pass
effects.descriptionZh: 旋转的波束照亮光点，光点渐暗，等下一圈再亮

effects.title: Heart monitor
effects.description: A green heartbeat trace writes across, wiping as it goes
effects.descriptionZh: 绿色心跳曲线横向写过屏幕，边写边擦

effects.title: Spectrum analyser
effects.description: Bars jump to a beat while their peak caps hang, then drop
effects.descriptionZh: 柱条随节拍跳动，峰值帽停一下再落下

effects.title: Neon tubes
effects.description: Bright coloured glass snakes across a dark wall
effects.descriptionZh: 明亮的彩色玻璃在暗墙上蜿蜒

effects.title: Targeting HUD
effects.description: A sight follows your pointer and locks onto nearby blips
effects.descriptionZh: 准星跟随你的指针，锁定附近的光点

effects.title: Fade & scale in
effects.description: Old shop cards leave fast and new ones rise in, one by one
effects.descriptionZh: 旧的商品卡片迅速离开，新的逐张升起

effects.title: Stagger grid
effects.description: A colour change ripples out from the tapped swatch
effects.descriptionZh: 颜色变化从被点的色块向外扩散

effects.title: Easing curves race
effects.description: Four toggles side by side show why ease-out feels fastest
effects.descriptionZh: 四个并排的开关，说明为什么 ease-out 感觉最快

effects.title: 3D card flip
effects.description: Turns over to show the back when the CVC field is in focus
effects.descriptionZh: CVC 输入框获得焦点时，翻过来露出背面

effects.title: Anticipation & follow-through
effects.description: A product crouches, hops into the bag and the handle swings
effects.descriptionZh: 商品先蹲一下，跳进购物袋，提手随之晃动

effects.title: List reorder (FLIP)
effects.description: Leaderboard rows glide to new ranks, climbers passing above
effects.descriptionZh: 排行榜各行滑向新名次，上升的从上方越过

effects.title: Add & remove
effects.description: An item fades, the rest close the gap, and Undo reverses it
effects.descriptionZh: 一件商品淡出，其余补上空位，撤销则全部还原

effects.title: Number ticker
effects.description: Each digit rolls to its new value when a stat changes
effects.descriptionZh: 数据变化时，每一位数字滚动到新值

effects.title: Accordion FAQ
effects.description: Answers open one at a time, the text a beat behind
effects.descriptionZh: 答案一次展开一个，文字稍晚一拍出现

effects.title: Tab swap
effects.description: A dark pill stretches to the picked item, front edge first
effects.descriptionZh: 深色胶囊伸展到选中的一项，前缘先到

effects.title: Push slide
effects.description: A new screen sweeps in as the old one drifts back and dims
effects.descriptionZh: 新屏幕进来，旧屏幕往后退并变暗

effects.title: Circle reveal
effects.description: Tap anywhere and the new theme floods out from that point
effects.descriptionZh: 点击任意位置，新主题从那一点铺开

effects.title: Staircase wipe
effects.description: Coloured bars sweep down over the page and carry on out
effects.descriptionZh: 彩色色条依次扫下页面，然后继续向下离开

effects.title: Shared-element expand
effects.description: A product photo grows from its card into the page header
effects.descriptionZh: 商品照片从卡片里放大，成为页面头图

effects.title: View Transitions morph
effects.description: An album cover grows into the open album’s header, and back
effects.descriptionZh: 专辑封面放大成打开后的专辑头图，再缩回去

effects.title: iOS sheet
effects.description: A panel slides up while the page behind steps back and dims
effects.descriptionZh: 面板从底部升起，后面的页面后退并变暗

effects.title: Lightbox zoom
effects.description: A thumbnail grows into a full-screen photo and shrinks back
effects.descriptionZh: 缩略图放大成全屏照片，再缩回原位

effects.title: Directional tabs
effects.description: Products slide in from the side of the category you picked
effects.descriptionZh: 商品从所选分类的那一侧滑入

effects.title: Blur crossfade
effects.description: Grid view melts into list view without a messy double image
effects.descriptionZh: 网格视图融入列表视图，没有杂乱的重影

effects.title: Card stack swipe
effects.description: Photos tilt, get stamped Keep or Delete and fly off the pile
effects.descriptionZh: 照片倾斜、盖上保留或删除的章，然后飞出

effects.title: Page turn
effects.description: A book flips its own leaves; drag the right one to try it
effects.descriptionZh: 书页自己一张张掀起；拖动右侧那张试试

effects.title: Letter rise stagger
effects.description: A name springs up from a hidden edge, one character at a time
effects.descriptionZh: 名字从隐藏的边缘升起，一个字符接一个字符

effects.title: Scramble decode
effects.description: Random characters churn, then lock into words left to right
effects.descriptionZh: 随机字符不断翻动，再从左到右定格成文字

effects.title: Variable-font wave
effects.description: A bulge of weight and width rolls along a word
effects.descriptionZh: 字重和字宽的鼓包沿着一个词滚过

effects.title: Typewriter
effects.description: A search box types example trips with human pauses
effects.descriptionZh: 搜索框自己打出示例行程，停顿像真人一样

effects.title: Line mask reveal
effects.description: Headline rows slide up one by one from a hidden edge
effects.descriptionZh: 标题分几段依次从隐藏的边缘滑上来

effects.title: Split-flap board
effects.description: Letters flip like an airport departures sign
effects.descriptionZh: 字母一格格跳转，像机场的航班信息屏

effects.title: Odometer counter
effects.description: A charity total rolls up with each new gift, wheel by wheel
effects.descriptionZh: 慈善总额随每笔捐款滚动上涨，一轮接一轮

effects.title: Rotating word
effects.description: The end of a headline keeps changing, sliding through a slot
effects.descriptionZh: 标题末尾的词不断更换，从一道窄缝里滑过

effects.title: Marker highlight
effects.description: A wobbly pen stroke sweeps behind key phrases, line by line
effects.descriptionZh: 一道不太整齐的笔触扫过关键句子，一行一笔

effects.title: Text on a circle
effects.description: A ring of words turns slowly; move over it to spin it up
effects.descriptionZh: 一圈文字缓缓转动；移到上面可让它转快

effects.title: Type ribbon
effects.description: Words run round a twisting Möbius band; move to tilt the view
effects.descriptionZh: 文字沿着扭转的莫比乌斯带不停流动；移动指针可倾斜视角

effects.title: Parallax layers
effects.description: Far mountains lag as the page scrolls, near ones keep pace
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动时远山落在后面，近处的跟得上

effects.title: Scrub reveal
effects.description: A statement lights up word by word as you scroll
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动时，一句话一个词一个词地亮起

effects.title: Pinned horizontal track
effects.description: Scrolling down slides a row of projects sideways
effects.descriptionZh: 向下滚动时，一排项目向侧边滑动

effects.title: Zoom-through
effects.description: Scrolling flies you inside the O of a giant word
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动让你飞进一个巨大单词的 O 里

effects.title: Velocity-skew marquee
effects.description: Scrolling text races and leans the faster you flick
effects.descriptionZh: 滑得越快，文字跑得越快、倾斜得越厉害

effects.title: Reading progress
effects.description: A thin bar fills as you read and the minutes left count down
effects.descriptionZh: 细条随阅读填满，剩余分钟数随之减少

effects.title: Sticky card stack
effects.description: Steps pile up as you scroll, older ones shrinking back
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动时步骤卡层层叠起，旧的往后缩

effects.title: Timeline draw
effects.description: A line grows down the page as you scroll, years popping in
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动时一条线沿页面向下延伸，年份逐个弹出

effects.title: Image-sequence scrub
effects.description: A shoe turns a full circle as you scroll, frame by frame
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动时一只跑鞋一帧一帧地转完一圈

effects.title: Snap gallery
effects.description: Photos click into place one by one, the centre one growing
effects.descriptionZh: 照片一张张卡入位置，中间那张放大

effects.title: Magnetic button
effects.description: Leans toward the pointer as it nears, the label leaning further
effects.descriptionZh: 指针靠近时向它倾斜，文字倾斜得更多

effects.title: Click ripple
effects.description: Press a button and a soft circle spreads from the exact spot
effects.descriptionZh: 按下按钮，柔和的圆圈从按下的那一点扩散

effects.title: 3D tilt card
effects.description: Turns toward the cursor and lifts, catching a sliding glare
effects.descriptionZh: 朝光标转动并微微抬起，一道反光滑过

effects.title: Cursor trail
effects.description: A warm ribbon follows the pointer and curls with every move
effects.descriptionZh: 一条暖色丝带跟着指针，随每个动作卷曲

effects.title: Spotlight reveal
effects.description: A soft torch follows the cursor through a dark veil
effects.descriptionZh: 一束柔光跟着光标，照亮暗色面纱下的内容

effects.title: Image follow
effects.description: Move down a project list and each preview trails the cursor
effects.descriptionZh: 在项目列表中往下移，每个预览图都跟着光标

effects.title: Directional fill
effects.description: Colour floods in from the side you enter, out the side you leave
effects.descriptionZh: 颜色从你进入的一侧涌入，从你离开的一侧退出

effects.title: Sliding underline
effects.description: One nav marker stretches to whichever link you point at
effects.descriptionZh: 一条导航标记伸展到你指向的链接

effects.title: Lit border
effects.description: Card edges in a dark grid light up around the cursor
effects.descriptionZh: 暗色网格中的卡片边缘在光标周围亮起

effects.title: Dock magnify
effects.description: Icons swell under the cursor and push their neighbours apart
effects.descriptionZh: 图标在光标下变大，把相邻图标推开

effects.title: Toggle spring
effects.description: Tap a switch and its knob stretches as it slides, then lands
effects.descriptionZh: 点击开关，滑块滑动时拉长，然后落定

effects.title: Like burst
effects.description: Tap the heart and it squashes, pops and fires a ring of dots
effects.descriptionZh: 点击爱心，它被压扁、弹起，并迸出一圈小点

effects.title: Submit to success
effects.description: Tap Send; the button becomes a spinner, then a green tick
effects.descriptionZh: 点击发送，按钮变成加载圈，再变成绿色对勾

effects.title: Arc spinner
effects.description: A loading ring whose stroke grows and shrinks as it turns
effects.descriptionZh: 一个加载圈，旋转时笔画时长时短

effects.title: Skeleton shimmer
effects.description: Grey placeholders hold the layout until real items fade in
effects.descriptionZh: 灰色占位块撑住版面，直到真实内容淡入

effects.title: Copy to tick
effects.description: Tap Copy and the icon becomes a check with a Copied label
effects.descriptionZh: 点击复制，图标变成勾号，并出现“已复制”标签

effects.title: Password strength
effects.description: A meter fills and rules tick off as the text is typed
effects.descriptionZh: 随着输入，强度条填满，各项规则逐一打勾

effects.title: Hold to delete
effects.description: Press and hold to fill the button red; let go early to undo
effects.descriptionZh: 按住让按钮填满红色；提前松手即可取消

effects.title: Bell and badge
effects.description: Each new alert rings it, and the count pops up or rolls on
effects.descriptionZh: 每来一条新提醒它就响一下，数字弹出或滚动增加

effects.title: Toast stack
effects.description: New messages rise in front as older ones step back and fade
effects.descriptionZh: 新消息在前方升起，旧消息往后退并淡去

effects.title: Squash & stretch bounce
effects.description: Tap Add to bag and a mug flies in, squashing as it lands
effects.descriptionZh: 点击加入购物袋，杯子飞进去，落地时被压扁

effects.title: Rubber-band drag
effects.description: Drag past the last photo and it resists, then springs back
effects.descriptionZh: 拖过最后一张照片，它会越拉越紧，然后弹回

effects.title: Pendulum wave
effects.description: Glowing weights drift out of step, snake about, then line up
effects.descriptionZh: 发光的重物逐渐错开，蛇形起伏，再重新排齐

effects.title: Verlet rope
effects.description: Tug the lamp’s pull cord to switch it, or flick it to swing
effects.descriptionZh: 拉一下台灯的拉绳开关灯，或拨一下让它晃起来

effects.title: Ball collisions
effects.description: Tap a bubble to grow it and watch it shove the rest aside
effects.descriptionZh: 点击一个气泡让它变大，看它把其他气泡挤开

effects.title: Snap-point bottom sheet
effects.description: Fling the map panel and it springs to the nearest stop
effects.descriptionZh: 甩动地图面板，它会弹到最近的停靠位

effects.title: Swipe to dismiss
effects.description: Flick a notification away and the rest close the gap
effects.descriptionZh: 划走一条通知，其余的补上空位

effects.title: Chat heads
effects.description: Drag the bubbles; they trail in a chain and dock at an edge
effects.descriptionZh: 拖动气泡，它们排成一串跟随，然后停靠在边缘

effects.title: Jelly app icon
effects.description: Drag it to a new slot; it stretches, then wobbles as it lands
effects.descriptionZh: 把它拖到新位置，它会拉长，落下时晃动

effects.title: Pull to refresh
effects.description: Drag the inbox down; it resists, waits, then springs back
effects.descriptionZh: 向下拉收件箱，它会抵抗、停住，然后弹回

effects.title: Shape morph
effects.description: Album covers melt into the next track’s outline and colour
effects.descriptionZh: 专辑封面融成下一首歌的轮廓和颜色

effects.title: Icon morph
effects.description: Tap and a download arrow folds into a check, a list into a grid
effects.descriptionZh: 点击后，下载箭头折成勾号，列表变成网格

effects.title: Gooey blobs
effects.description: Tap the add button and its actions ooze out like liquid
effects.descriptionZh: 点击添加按钮，各个操作像液体一样渗出来

effects.title: Line draw-on
effects.description: Chart strokes trace the week, one just after the other
effects.descriptionZh: 图表线条描出一周走势，第二条紧随其后

effects.title: Liquid button
effects.description: Move over it and its edge ripples; press to squeeze it
effects.descriptionZh: 移到按钮上，边缘会荡漾；按下可挤压它

effects.title: Play to pause
effects.description: Tap and the triangle splits and slides into two bars
effects.descriptionZh: 点击后，三角形一分为二，滑成两条竖杠

effects.title: Menu to close
effects.description: Tap and three lines fold into an X as the panel wipes open
effects.descriptionZh: 点击后，三条线折成一个 X，面板随之展开

effects.title: Chart morph
effects.description: Tap a range and the line flows into the new data
effects.descriptionZh: 点击一个时间段，曲线流向新数据

effects.title: Logo draw
effects.description: A brand mark traces itself like a pen, then fills in
effects.descriptionZh: 一个品牌图形像笔画一样描出，再填满颜色

effects.title: Button to menu
effects.description: Tap Share and it opens out into a list of options
effects.descriptionZh: 点击分享，按钮展开成一列选项

effects.title: Dynamic island
effects.description: The camera pill grows into calls and music; tap to open the player
effects.descriptionZh: 摄像头周围的胶囊变成来电和音乐；点击可打开播放器
